documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Yaap Digital Limited held its maiden earnings conference call as a listed company for H2 FY26, reporting strong year-on-year growth in income, EBITDA, and net profit. Management highlighted the strategic acquisition of Gozoop and the HAWK online reputation management platform to enhance capabilities in creative services, brand strategy, and technology. The company outlined its mid-term growth strategy focusing on AI integration, proprietary technology platforms, strategic acquisitions in the creator economy, and geographic expansion. Management also discussed seasonal revenue skews towards the second half of the fiscal year, robust client retention driven by integrated service offerings, and targeted market share goals in the Indian digital marketing sector. Yaap Digital reported strong financial performance for FY26, highlighting growth in total income, EBITDA, and PAT, along with successful client additions and client retention.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the 18% EBITDA margin achieved in H2 is sustainable going ahead, give or take 1% or 2%.
guidance.quote: Pretty much, pretty much sustainable, give or take a 1% or 2%.

guidance.claim: Management expects operating cash flow to convert between 60% to 70% of EBITDA going ahead.
guidance.quote: I think it should be anywhere between 60% to 70% going ahead.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that almost 75% of all BFSI client spends happen in H2.
demand_outlook.quote: Almost 75% of all their spends happen in H2.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian digital landscape is driven by rising smartphone usage, affordable data, and the dominance of video platforms with billions of monthly viewing hours.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s digital landscape is driven by rising smartphone usage, affordable data, and the dominance of video platforms with billions of monthly viewing hours.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumers increasingly seek personalized, tech-enabled experiences while interactive formats shape more engaging campaigns.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumers increasingly seek personalized, tech-enabled experiences, while interactive formats like live streaming, virtual reality and augmented reality are shaping more engaging campaigns

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that influencer marketing is on the rise.
demand_outlook.quote:
Influencer Marketing
is On the Rise!

capex_expansion.claim: Management is actively looking for one acquisition in the creator economy space in the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: No, there's no immediate timeline, but we would definitely look at one acquisition in this financial year at least.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the Gozoop acquisition was structured across three years at an 8x multiple of EBITDA.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, so the Gozoop acquisition is structured across three years. It was done at a 8x multiple of EBITDA.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning aggressive growth through upcoming acquisitions specifically in the creator tech space.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning aggressive growth through upcoming acquisitions specifically in the creator tech space, while simultaneously building our own proprietary technology tailored for media and content creators.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are actively expanding their geographical footprint to bring capabilities to a larger global market.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this technological leap, we are actively expanding our geographical footprint to bring our unique capabilities to a much larger global market.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that business margins are primarily defined by the non-media business, which is the third D or distribution part.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, so basically, if you see in our business, the margins are primarily defined by the non-media business, which is the third D, which is distribution in our bit.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the non-media business carries higher margins compared to media businesses.
margins_costs.quote: No, the non-media business has higher margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that 70% of all business is recurring.
Management noted that the top 10 clients contribute about 40% to revenue and this concentration is decreasing rapidly.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our top 10 clients would contribute to about, say, 40%-odd and this is decreasing rapidly.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with 400+ people across 8 offices in 3 countries.
orders_capacity.quote: With 400+ people across 8 offices in 3 countries, we work with global multinationals, regional and local clients, and youth-driven influencer brands — in a 24/7 environment where culture moves faster than calendars.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties like government actions, local, political or economic developments, and technological risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties like government actions, local, political or economic developments, technological risks, and many other factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those contemplated by the relevant forward-looking statements.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an internal three-year goal to achieve a 2% market share of the addressable agency business market in India.
management_commitments.quote: So internally for us, 2% market share of the addressable market, which is the agency business in India, is what we're gunning for three years from now.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to complete at least one acquisition in the AI tech-led creator economy space within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: No, there's no immediate timeline, but we would definitely look at one acquisition in this financial year at least.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are hyper-focused on engineering the agency of the future scaled by technology and structured for sustainable, long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, we are hyper-focused on engineering the agency of the future—one that is scaled by technology, powered by creativity, and structured for sustainable, long-term growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to doubling down on maximizing AI within everyday workflows across media, content, influencer marketing, and creative production.
management_commitments.quote: Central to this future outlook is our commitment to doubling down on maximizing AI within our everyday workflows across media, content, influencer marketing, and creative production.

management_commitments.claim: The company's 3-year goals include achieving 2% market share.
The company's 3-year goals include generating 75% of revenue from AI-powered tech.
management_commitments.quote: 75% Revenue to come from AI-powered tech

management_commitments.claim: The company's 3-year goals include becoming the #1 Digital Marketing Company.
The company's 3-year goals include reaching 1000+ people and 12+ locations.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
